name: Max Financial Services Limited
remarksWeb: Max Ventures Investment Holdings Private Limited (MVIHL), a promoter entity, had sold 16,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 2/- each, constituting 0.46% equity capital of the Company through the open market on November 21, 2025.  After the aforesaid transaction, the promoter holding in the Company has decreased to 43,16,256 (1.25%) equity shares as of December 31, 2025 from 59,16,256 (1.71%) equity shares as of September 30, 2025.           In this regard, necessary disclosures were filed with BSE Ltd. and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under Regulation 7(2)(b) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

name: Max Financial Services Limited
remarksWeb: There has been a change in the promoter shareholding from the details reported as of June 30, 2025, due to the reclassification of Ms. Neelu Analjit Singh, who holds 1,00,000 (0.03%) equity shares of Rs. 2/- each, from the Promoter and Promoter Group category to the Public category. The Company received No Objection Letters from both BSE and NSE on July 29, 2025, and the re-classification was duly communicated to both exchanges on the same date. As a result, the promoter shareholding decreased from 60,16,256 (1.74%) equity shares as on June 30, 2025 to 59,16,256 (1.71%) equity shares of Rs. 2/- each as of the quarter ended on September 30, 2025.

name: Max Financial Services Limited
revisionRemark: As desired, the revised shareholding pattern to be submitted with the Promoter Group entities details
